mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following a 0.3pp UNRATE rise over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over two months indicate severe consumer demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS declines over two months.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, prompting recession expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following a rising HOUST trend.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following a CPIAUCSL monthly rise > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) over one month indicate sharp labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following simultaneous PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing real GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized) signals economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.0% annualized.
